an5.95:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati
an5.95:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu atthapaṭisambhidāppatto hoti dhammapaṭisambhidāppatto hoti niruttipaṭibhidāppatto hoti paṭibhāṇapaṭisambhidāppatto hoti yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati
an5.95:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhatīti.
